threads.subject: Cracked chainstay on my Lumen Commuter

messages.text:
Hi Lumen team,

I noticed a hairline crack on the left chainstay of my Commuter this morning, right by the dropout. The bike is seven months old and I mostly ride it to work on paved roads.

My order number is LB-20417. Is this covered by the frame warranty? I'd rather not ride it until someone has looked at it.

Thanks,
Ana

Hello, I ordered a Lumen Cargo nine days ago (LB-20488) and haven't had a shipping email yet. Can you check?

Marcus

Hi Marcus,

Sorry for the wait. Your Cargo left our warehouse on Tuesday with DHL, tracking 00340434292135100186. It usually takes 3–4 working days.

Best,
Lumen Support
Thanks, but the tracking hasn't moved in three days. It still says 'handed to carrier'. Is it lost?

messages.text: Hi, I ordered a size L Commuter (LB-20391) but at 1.74 m it's too big for me. It's unridden. Can I swap it for an M?

Hi Tomás,

Of course. I've emailed a prepaid return label separately. Once the L is scanned at the depot we'll ship the M the same day.

Lumen Support
Love the bike! One thing: the kickstand rattles a lot on cobbled streets. Is there a fix?
Thanks Hannah! Tightening the kickstand bolt to 8 Nm usually fixes it. We're also shipping a rubber damper with new bikes from next month and can post you one.
